title: Displant
summary: DISPLANT, verb transitive [dis and plant.] 1. To pluck up or to remove a plant. 2. To drive away or remove from the usual place of residence; as, to displant the people of a country. 3. To strip of in

inlines.v: DISPLANT, verb transitive [dis and plant.] 1. To pluck up or to remove a plant. 2. To drive away or remove from the usual place of residence; as, to displant the people of a country. 3. To strip of inhabitants; as, to displant a country.
